note: Stories in the order the events are told, not the order the books were written. The text is the same public-domain library as thebookandme.com.

stories.title: Creation
stories.blurb: The world is spoken into being, and the seventh day is blessed.

stories.title: The garden
stories.blurb: The human is formed from the ground, and the woman from his side.

stories.title: The fall
stories.blurb: The serpent, the fruit, and the way out of the garden.

stories.title: Cain and Abel
stories.blurb: The first brothers, the first murder, and a mark of protection.

stories.title: The watchers come down
stories.blurb: Angels descend for the daughters of men, teach forbidden arts, and are sentenced. A telling older than the New Testament, and quoted by Jude.

stories.title: Enoch intercedes
stories.blurb: Enoch is sent to the fallen watchers with heaven's answer.

stories.title: From Adam to Noah
stories.blurb: The long generations, and Enoch, who walked with God and was not.

stories.title: The birth of Noah
stories.blurb: A child born shining, and a frightened father sent to ask Enoch what it means.

stories.title: The flood
stories.blurb: Noah builds the ark, the waters rise, and the bow is set in the cloud.

stories.title: The flood, as Jubilees tells it
stories.blurb: The same waters, told again with the watchers written into the story.

stories.title: Noah's vineyard
stories.blurb: After the flood, wine, shame, and a word spoken over the sons.

stories.title: The tower of Babel
stories.blurb: One language, one tower, and the scattering of the peoples.

stories.title: The call of Abram
stories.blurb: Leave your country. A promise of land, a family, and a name.

stories.title: Abram and Lot part ways
stories.blurb: The herdsmen quarrel, and Lot chooses the plain of the Jordan.

stories.title: The rescue of Lot
stories.blurb: Abram brings Lot back from the kings, and Melchizedek brings bread and wine.

stories.title: The covenant of the pieces
stories.blurb: A smoking torch passes between the cut animals, and the promise is sealed.

stories.title: Hagar and Ishmael
stories.blurb: Sarai gives Hagar to Abram. Hagar flees, and a messenger finds her at a spring.

stories.title: The covenant of circumcision
stories.blurb: Abram becomes Abraham, Sarai becomes Sarah, and the sign is given.

stories.title: Three visitors
stories.blurb: Abraham hosts three strangers under the oaks, and Sarah laughs.

stories.title: Abraham pleads for the city
stories.blurb: Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked? He bargains down to ten.

stories.title: Sodom and Gomorrah
stories.blurb: Lot's guests, the mob at the door, and a city left behind.

stories.title: Abraham, Sarah, and Abimelech
stories.blurb: Sarah is taken into a king's house, and a dream gives her back.

stories.title: Isaac is born
stories.blurb: The child of the promise, and Hagar sent out with Ishmael into the wilderness.

stories.title: The binding of Isaac
stories.blurb: Take your son, your only son. A ram is caught in the thicket.

stories.title: The binding, as Jubilees tells it
stories.blurb: The same mountain, with Mastema named as the one who proposed the test.

stories.title: A burial place
stories.blurb: Sarah dies, and Abraham buys the cave of Machpelah.

stories.title: A wife for Isaac
stories.blurb: A servant at a well, and Rebekah who says, I will go.

stories.title: Jacob and Esau are born
stories.blurb: The birthright sold for a meal of lentils.

stories.title: Isaac and the wells
stories.blurb: Famine, a lie about Rebekah, and wells dug, stopped, and dug again.

stories.title: Jacob takes the blessing
stories.blurb: Rebekah's plan, goatskins on his arms, and Esau's cry.

stories.title: Jacob's ladder
stories.blurb: A stone for a pillow, a stairway, and a vow at Bethel.

stories.title: Leah, Rachel, and the years with Laban
stories.blurb: Seven years, the wrong bride, and a household of children.

stories.title: Jacob flees Laban
stories.blurb: The household gods hidden in a saddle, and a heap of stones as a border.

stories.title: Jacob wrestles
stories.blurb: Alone at the Jabbok, he will not let go until he is blessed. His name becomes Israel.

stories.title: Jacob and Esau meet
stories.blurb: Esau runs to meet him, and they weep.

stories.title: Dinah
stories.blurb: Shechem, a deception, and Simeon and Levi's revenge.

stories.title: Rachel dies, and Isaac dies
stories.blurb: Benjamin is born on the road, and Rachel is buried there.

stories.title: Joseph and the pit
stories.blurb: The coat, the dreams, and brothers who sell him on.

stories.title: Judah and Tamar
stories.blurb: A widow left waiting, and a pledge of seal, cord, and staff.

stories.title: Joseph in Potiphar's house
stories.blurb: The lie, the prison, and a man the jailer trusts.

stories.title: The baker and the cupbearer
stories.blurb: Two dreams in prison, and one man who forgets.

stories.title: Pharaoh's dreams
stories.blurb: Seven fat cows, seven thin, and a prisoner made governor.

stories.title: The brothers come to Egypt
stories.blurb: Grain in a famine, a hidden cup, and Judah who offers himself instead.

stories.title: Joseph tells them who he is
stories.blurb: I am Joseph. Is my father still alive?

stories.title: Israel comes to Egypt
stories.blurb: The family settles in Goshen, and Jacob blesses Pharaoh.

stories.title: Jacob blesses his sons
stories.blurb: The younger grandson set ahead, and a word for each of the twelve.

stories.title: The deaths of Jacob and Joseph
stories.blurb: Carried back to the cave, and Joseph's bones left for the promise.

stories.title: Job is tested
stories.blurb: A blameless man, a wager in the heavenly court, and everything taken. The poems sit between these chapters. The story itself is the frame.

stories.title: Oppressed in Egypt
stories.blurb: A new king who did not know Joseph, and an order against the boys.

stories.title: Moses is born and flees
stories.blurb: A basket in the reeds, a prince, a killing, and a well in Midian.

stories.title: The burning bush
stories.blurb: I AM WHO I AM, and a staff that becomes a snake.

stories.title: Bricks without straw
stories.blurb: Pharaoh makes the work harder, and the people turn on Moses.

stories.title: The plagues
stories.blurb: Blood, frogs, gnats, flies, livestock, boils, hail, locusts, darkness, and the warning of the last.

stories.title: The plagues, as Jubilees tells them
stories.blurb: Mastema standing against Moses, and the night the firstborn die.

stories.title: The Passover
stories.blurb: Blood on the doorposts, unleavened bread, and a people walking out.

stories.title: The sea
stories.blurb: The water stands up, the army follows, and the water returns.

stories.title: The song of the sea
stories.blurb: Miriam takes a tambourine. The oldest poem in the collection is this one.

stories.title: Manna, water, and Amalek
stories.blurb: Bitter water made sweet, bread on the ground, a rock struck, and hands held up in a battle.

stories.title: Jethro's advice
stories.blurb: Moses' father-in-law watches him wear himself out, and tells him to share the work.

stories.title: Sinai and the ten words
stories.blurb: The mountain smokes, and the commandments are spoken.

stories.title: The golden calf
stories.blurb: A god made of earrings, tablets shattered, and Moses standing in the breach.

stories.title: Show me your glory
stories.blurb: Moses asks to see God, and new tablets are written.

stories.title: The tabernacle is set up
stories.blurb: The cloud covers the tent, and the glory fills it.

stories.title: Nadab and Abihu
stories.blurb: Strange fire, and two priests who die before the Lord.

stories.title: The spies
stories.blurb: A land of milk and honey, a bad report, and forty years in the wilderness.

stories.title: Korah's rebellion
stories.blurb: The ground opens, and fire comes out.

stories.title: The rock, and the death of Aaron
stories.blurb: Moses strikes the rock he was told to speak to. Aaron dies on Mount Hor.

stories.title: The bronze serpent
stories.blurb: Serpents in the camp, and a bronze one lifted up.

stories.title: Balaam and the donkey
stories.blurb: A prophet hired to curse Israel blesses them instead. The donkey sees the angel first.

stories.title: Baal of Peor
stories.blurb: The camp joins itself to another god, and Phinehas acts.

stories.title: The daughters of Zelophehad
stories.blurb: Five sisters stand before Moses and ask for their father's inheritance.

stories.title: The song of Moses
stories.blurb: Give ear, heavens, and I will speak. A song taught to the people before he dies.

stories.title: The death of Moses
stories.blurb: He sees the land, and he does not cross into it. No one knows his grave.

stories.title: Rahab and the spies
stories.blurb: A scarlet cord in the window of a house on the wall.

stories.title: Crossing the Jordan
stories.blurb: The priests stand in the river, and twelve stones are carried out.

stories.title: The commander of the Lord's army
stories.blurb: A man with a drawn sword, and Joshua told to take off his sandals.

stories.title: Jericho
stories.blurb: Seven days of trumpets, and the wall falls down flat.

stories.title: Achan and Ai
stories.blurb: A hidden robe and a wedge of gold, a defeat, and a second assault.

stories.title: The Gibeonites
stories.blurb: Worn-out sacks and moldy bread, and a treaty made by a trick.

stories.title: The sun stands still
stories.blurb: Five kings in a cave, and a day that does not end on schedule.

stories.title: Caleb asks for the hill country
stories.blurb: Forty-five years later, he is still as strong, and he wants Hebron.

stories.title: Joshua's farewell
stories.blurb: Choose this day whom you will serve. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

stories.title: Ehud
stories.blurb: A left-handed man, a hidden sword, and a king left alone in his cool roof chamber.

stories.title: Deborah, Barak, and Jael
stories.blurb: A prophet who judges Israel, a general who will not go without her, and a tent peg.

stories.title: Gideon
stories.blurb: A fleece, three hundred men, and torches in jars.

stories.title: Abimelech
stories.blurb: A bramble king, a curse from Jotham, and a millstone from a tower.

stories.title: Jephthah
stories.blurb: An outcast called back to lead, a rash vow, and his daughter.

stories.title: The birth of Samson
stories.blurb: A woman who had borne no child, and a messenger who will not give his name.

stories.title: Samson's riddle
stories.blurb: A lion, honey in the carcass, and a riddle at a wedding.

stories.title: The jawbone
stories.blurb: Foxes and torches, and a thousand with the jawbone of a donkey.

stories.title: Samson and Delilah
stories.blurb: The secret of his hair, the pillars of the temple, and the end of it.

stories.title: Micah's idol
stories.blurb: A hired priest, a stolen shrine, and the tribe of Dan looking for a home.

stories.title: The Levite's concubine
stories.blurb: A night in Gibeah, a body sent out in pieces, and a war inside Israel. One of the darkest stories in the book.

stories.title: Ruth
stories.blurb: A widow who will not go back, a field, a kinsman, and a child who will be David's grandfather.

stories.title: Hannah's prayer
stories.blurb: A woman weeping at the shrine, a child lent to the Lord, and a song.

stories.title: The Lord calls Samuel
stories.blurb: A boy who thinks it is Eli, until Eli tells him to answer.

stories.title: The ark is captured
stories.blurb: Ichabod, the glory departed, and a god who topples Dagon in his own temple.

stories.title: Israel asks for a king
stories.blurb: They want to be like the other nations. Samuel warns them what a king will take.

stories.title: Saul is anointed
stories.blurb: Lost donkeys, a seer, and a shy man who hides among the baggage.

stories.title: Saul's first victory
stories.blurb: Ammon threatens Jabesh, and Saul cuts a yoke of oxen into pieces.

stories.title: Saul is rejected
stories.blurb: A sacrifice he was not to offer, and a king of Amalek he was told to spare and did not.

stories.title: David is anointed
stories.blurb: The youngest son, kept out with the sheep, and a spirit that comes on him.

stories.title: David and Goliath
stories.blurb: Five stones, a sling, and a giant who has defied the armies of Israel.

stories.title: David and Jonathan
stories.blurb: A covenant between them, a spear thrown, and arrows shot as a signal.

stories.title: David on the run
stories.blurb: Holy bread, a feigned madness, and the priests of Nob killed for helping him.

stories.title: David spares Saul in the cave
stories.blurb: Saul comes in to relieve himself. David cuts the corner of his robe and will not strike.

stories.title: Abigail
stories.blurb: A foolish husband, a wise wife with loaves and wine, and David talked back from bloodshed.

stories.title: David spares Saul again
stories.blurb: He takes the spear and the water jug from beside the sleeping king.

stories.title: The medium of Endor
stories.blurb: Saul, forbidden his own oracles, asks a woman to call Samuel up.

stories.title: David among the Philistines
stories.blurb: He lives in Ziklag, is refused the battle, and comes home to a town burned.

stories.title: The death of Saul
stories.blurb: The battle on Gilboa, and Saul falls on his own sword.

stories.title: David's lament
stories.blurb: How the mighty have fallen. He kills the man who claimed to have finished Saul.

stories.title: David becomes king
stories.blurb: First over Judah, then over all Israel, and Jerusalem taken.

stories.title: The ark comes to Jerusalem
stories.blurb: Uzzah dies for steadying it. David dances, and Michal despises him.

stories.title: God's promise to David
stories.blurb: You will not build me a house. I will build you one, a throne that lasts.

stories.title: Mephibosheth
stories.blurb: Jonathan's son, lame in both feet, is given a place at the king's table.

stories.title: David and Bathsheba
stories.blurb: A woman seen from a roof, a husband sent to his death, and Nathan's story of a lamb.

stories.title: Amnon and Tamar
stories.blurb: A brother's violence, and Absalom's silence that lasts two years.

stories.title: Absalom's rebellion
stories.blurb: A prince who steals the hearts of Israel, a king walking barefoot out of his city, and a death in an oak.

stories.title: David returns
stories.blurb: The king who cannot stop grieving, and a kingdom he has to win back gently.

stories.title: The census
stories.blurb: David numbers the people, a plague follows, and he buys a threshing floor.

stories.title: Solomon asks for wisdom
stories.blurb: An old king's last days, a rival son, and a young king who asks for a hearing heart.

stories.title: The temple
stories.blurb: Cedar and gold, the ark carried in, and a cloud so thick the priests cannot stand.

stories.title: The queen of Sheba
stories.blurb: She comes with hard questions and leaves with no more spirit in her.

stories.title: The kingdom tears
stories.blurb: Solomon's heart turns. A prophet tears a cloak into twelve pieces, and the north walks away.

stories.title: The man of God from Judah
stories.blurb: A prophet who denounces Jeroboam's altar, and then believes the wrong old man.

stories.title: Elijah and the widow
stories.blurb: Ravens, a jar of meal that does not fail, and a dead boy given back.

stories.title: Elijah on Carmel
stories.blurb: Four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal, a trench of water, and fire.

stories.title: Elijah at Horeb
stories.blurb: He asks to die under a broom tree. On the mountain, the Lord is not in the wind, the earthquake, or the fire.

stories.title: Naboth's vineyard
stories.blurb: A king who pouts, a queen who forges letters, and Elijah in the vineyard.

stories.title: The death of Ahab
stories.blurb: Four hundred prophets say go up. One says he saw a lying spirit. A random arrow finds the king.

stories.title: Elijah is taken up
stories.blurb: A chariot of fire, a cloak that parts the river, and boys who mock Elisha's baldness.

stories.title: Elisha's wonders
stories.blurb: The widow's oil, the Shunammite's son, death in the pot, and twenty loaves for a hundred men.

stories.title: Naaman
stories.blurb: A Syrian general, a servant girl, and a river he almost refuses to wash in.

stories.title: The axe head and the blinded army
stories.blurb: Iron floats. An army surrounding the prophet is led, eyes opened later, into Samaria and fed.

stories.title: The siege and the four lepers
stories.blurb: A city eating its desperation, and four lepers who find the enemy camp empty.

stories.title: Jehu
stories.blurb: A furious ride, Jezebel at the window, and a purge that does not stop where it should.

stories.title: Athaliah and Joash
stories.blurb: A queen who kills the royal children, one boy hidden in the temple, and a crown six years later.

stories.title: Jonah
stories.blurb: A prophet who runs, a fish, a city that repents, and a man angry that God is merciful.

stories.title: The fall of Samaria
stories.blurb: The northern kingdom ends. The writer says why.

stories.title: Hezekiah and Sennacherib
stories.blurb: The Assyrian envoy shouts at the wall. Isaiah sends a word. The army does not take the city.

stories.title: Hezekiah's illness
stories.blurb: Fifteen years more, a shadow that steps backward, and envoys from Babylon shown the treasury.

stories.title: Josiah finds the book
stories.blurb: Workmen in the temple turn up a scroll. The young king tears his clothes.

stories.title: Jerusalem falls
stories.blurb: The city is burned, the temple stripped, and a king eats at a foreign table.

stories.title: Daniel at the king's table
stories.blurb: Four young men refuse the royal food and are found wiser than the magicians.

stories.title: The fiery furnace
stories.blurb: A statue, a furnace heated seven times hotter, and a fourth figure in the fire.

stories.title: The prayer in the furnace
stories.blurb: The song Azariah and his companions sing in the fire, kept in the Greek Daniel and not in the Hebrew.

stories.title: The writing on the wall
stories.blurb: Belshazzar's feast, a hand, and MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN.

stories.title: The lions' den
stories.blurb: A law about prayer, a sealed stone, and a king who cannot sleep.

stories.title: Susanna
stories.blurb: Two elders, a garden, and a young Daniel who asks each of them which tree.

stories.title: Bel and the dragon
stories.blurb: Daniel exposes a priestly trick, kills a dragon, and is thrown to the lions a second time.

stories.title: Tobit's blindness
stories.blurb: A man who buries the dead goes blind. In another city, Sarah prays on the same day.

stories.title: Tobias, the fish, and Sarah
stories.blurb: An angel who gives a false name, a fish in the Tigris, and a demon driven off.

stories.title: Tobit sees again
stories.blurb: The gall of the fish, a father's sight, and the angel who finally says who he is.

stories.title: Judith
stories.blurb: A widow walks into the enemy camp, and Holofernes does not walk out.

stories.title: Esther becomes queen
stories.blurb: Vashti refuses the king. A Jewish orphan is chosen in her place, and her cousin uncovers a plot.

stories.title: Haman's plot
stories.blurb: A decree against a people, sackcloth in the street, and a queen who invites the king to a banquet.

stories.title: The tables turn
stories.blurb: A sleepless king, a gallows built for the wrong man, and a day rewritten.

stories.title: Esther, the Greek telling
stories.blurb: The same story with the prayers the Hebrew text leaves out, and with God's name spoken.

stories.title: The return
stories.blurb: Cyrus lets them go. The altar is rebuilt, and the old men weep when the foundation is laid.

stories.title: Ezra reads the law
stories.blurb: A scribe arrives with a commission, and the community faces what the book requires of their marriages.

stories.title: Nehemiah rebuilds the wall
stories.blurb: A cupbearer hears the wall is broken, asks the king, and builds with a tool in one hand.

stories.title: The law is read aloud
stories.blurb: From early morning until midday, and the people weep, and are told to go and eat what is rich.

stories.title: Antiochus and the desecration
stories.blurb: A Greek king puts a statue in the temple and forbids the law.

stories.title: Mattathias
stories.blurb: An old priest kills the king's officer at the altar in Modein and takes to the hills.

stories.title: Judas and the temple cleansed
stories.blurb: The hammer of the Maccabees, and the lamps lit again in a defiled temple. This is the story behind Hanukkah.

stories.title: The mother and her seven sons
stories.blurb: Seven brothers and their mother refuse the king's pork, one after another.

stories.title: The death of Judas
stories.blurb: Outnumbered, he fights anyway. How the mighty have fallen, the book says again.

stories.title: The elephants
stories.blurb: Jews of Alexandria are herded to be trampled. The elephants turn. A later, legendary telling of deliverance.

stories.title: The birth of Mary
stories.blurb: A later telling, not in the New Testament: Joachim and Anna, and the child Mary brought up in the temple.

stories.title: Zechariah is struck silent
stories.blurb: An old priest in the sanctuary, and a son promised. He asks for a sign and loses his speech.

stories.title: The annunciation
stories.blurb: Gabriel comes to Mary in Nazareth. Let it be to me according to your word.

stories.title: Mary visits Elizabeth
stories.blurb: The child leaps. Mary sings the Magnificat.

stories.title: The birth of John
stories.blurb: His name is John. Zechariah's mouth is opened, and he prophesies.

stories.title: Joseph's dream
stories.blurb: He resolves to dismiss her quietly. A dream tells him not to be afraid to take Mary as his wife.

stories.title: The birth in Bethlehem
stories.blurb: No room, a manger, and shepherds told first.

stories.title: The midwife and Salome
stories.blurb: A later telling of the birth in a cave, and Salome, whose hand is withered and healed.

stories.title: Simeon and Anna
stories.blurb: In the temple, an old man takes the child and says he can depart in peace.

stories.title: The magi and the flight
stories.blurb: A star, gifts, a jealous king, a road to Egypt, and the children of Bethlehem.

stories.title: The boy in the temple
stories.blurb: They lose him for three days and find him among the teachers.

stories.title: Childhood wonders
stories.blurb: A later, unsettling telling: a child who makes sparrows of clay and strikes, and heals, and grows. Not in the New Testament.

stories.title: John the Baptist
stories.blurb: A voice in the wilderness, a coat of camel's hair, and a baptism of repentance.

stories.title: The baptism
stories.blurb: Jesus comes up out of the water, and a voice speaks.

stories.title: The temptation
stories.blurb: Forty days, three offers, and angels afterward.

stories.title: The first disciples
stories.blurb: Follow me, and two sets of brothers leave their nets.

stories.title: A day in Capernaum
stories.blurb: A synagogue, a fever, a door crowded after sunset, and a departure before dawn.

stories.title: The catch of fish
stories.blurb: They have worked all night and caught nothing. The nets start to break.

stories.title: The leper
stories.blurb: If you are willing, you can make me clean. He touches him.

stories.title: The man let down through the roof
stories.blurb: Four friends, a hole in the tiles, and which is easier to say.

stories.title: The call of Levi
stories.blurb: A tax collector at his booth, and a dinner with the wrong people.

stories.title: The wedding at Cana
stories.blurb: They have no wine. The servants fill the jars with water.

stories.title: Nicodemus
stories.blurb: A ruler who comes by night, and a word about being born from above.

stories.title: The woman at the well
stories.blurb: A Samaritan woman, five husbands, and a town that comes out to see.

stories.title: The official's son
stories.blurb: Go, your son will live. He meets his servants on the road.

stories.title: Rejected at Nazareth
stories.blurb: He reads Isaiah in the synagogue where he grew up. They try to throw him off the hill.

stories.title: The withered hand
stories.blurb: Is it lawful to do good on the Sabbath? He tells the man to stretch out his hand.

stories.title: The twelve
stories.blurb: He appoints twelve to be with him and to be sent out.

stories.title: The sower
stories.blurb: A parable. Seed on the path, the rock, the thorns, and the good soil.

stories.title: The storm
stories.blurb: Asleep on a cushion. Peace. Be still. Who then is this?

stories.title: The man among the tombs
stories.blurb: A legion, a herd of pigs, and a man sent home to tell what happened.

stories.title: Jairus and the woman in the crowd
stories.blurb: Twelve years of bleeding, a touch of the hem, and a girl told to get up.

stories.title: The centurion's servant
stories.blurb: I am not worthy that you should come under my roof. Only say the word.

stories.title: The widow of Nain
stories.blurb: A funeral meets him at the gate. Young man, I tell you, get up.

stories.title: The woman with the ointment
stories.blurb: She weeps on his feet at a Pharisee's table. Her many sins are forgiven, for she loved much.

stories.title: The woman accused
stories.blurb: Let him who is without sin throw the first stone.

stories.title: The feeding of the five thousand
stories.blurb: Five loaves, two fish, and twelve baskets left over.

stories.title: Walking on the water
stories.blurb: He meant to pass by them. Take courage. It is I.

stories.title: The Syrophoenician woman
stories.blurb: Even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs. For that saying, her daughter is freed.

stories.title: The deaf man
stories.blurb: Ephphatha. Be opened.

stories.title: Peter's confession
stories.blurb: Who do you say that I am? You are the Christ. Then he begins to speak of the cross.

stories.title: The transfiguration
stories.blurb: Moses and Elijah, a cloud, and a voice. Peter offers to build three shelters.

stories.title: The boy with a spirit
stories.blurb: I believe. Help my unbelief.

stories.title: The man born blind
stories.blurb: Mud and the pool of Siloam, and a man the authorities would rather stayed blind.

stories.title: The good Samaritan
stories.blurb: A parable. A priest and a Levite pass by. A Samaritan does not.

stories.title: Martha and Mary
stories.blurb: One sister is distracted with much serving. The other has chosen the better part.

stories.title: The rich fool
stories.blurb: A parable. Bigger barns, and a soul required that night.

stories.title: The woman bent double
stories.blurb: Eighteen years. He sets her free on the Sabbath, and the ruler of the synagogue is indignant.

stories.title: The lost sheep, the coin, and the son
stories.blurb: Three parables of something lost and found, and a father who runs.

stories.title: The rich man and Lazarus
stories.blurb: A parable. A gate, a beggar, and a gulf that cannot be crossed.

stories.title: Ten lepers
stories.blurb: All ten are cleansed. One comes back, and he is a Samaritan.

stories.title: The Pharisee and the tax collector
stories.blurb: A parable. One thanks God he is not like other people. The other will not lift his eyes.

stories.title: The unforgiving servant
stories.blurb: A parable. A debt of millions forgiven, and a few dollars demanded of a fellow servant.

stories.title: The workers in the vineyard
stories.blurb: A parable. The last hired are paid the same as the first, and the first are angry.

stories.title: Zacchaeus
stories.blurb: A short man in a sycamore tree. Today I must stay at your house.

stories.title: Blind Bartimaeus
stories.blurb: He will not be silenced on the roadside. What do you want me to do for you?

stories.title: Lazarus
stories.blurb: Four days in the tomb. Jesus weeps. Lazarus, come out.

stories.title: Mary anoints Jesus
stories.blurb: A pound of perfume, the house filled with the fragrance, and a complaint about the poor.

stories.title: The entry into Jerusalem
stories.blurb: A colt that has never been ridden, and cloaks on the road.

stories.title: The temple cleared
stories.blurb: He overturns the tables. My house shall be called a house of prayer.

stories.title: The widow's coins
stories.blurb: She puts in two small copper coins, which is everything she has.

stories.title: The last supper
stories.blurb: This is my body. This is my blood. They sing, and go out to the mountain.

stories.title: He washes their feet
stories.blurb: The teacher takes a towel. One of them goes out into the night.

stories.title: Gethsemane
stories.blurb: Abba, Father. Not what I want, but what you want. They cannot stay awake.

stories.title: The arrest
stories.blurb: A kiss, a sword, a servant's ear, and a young man who runs away naked.

stories.title: The trial and Peter's denial
stories.blurb: False witnesses, a cockcrow, and Peter weeping.

stories.title: Before Pilate
stories.blurb: Are you the king of the Jews? Barabbas is released. Jesus is flogged.

stories.title: The crucifixion
stories.blurb: A purple cloak, a crown of thorns, the place of a skull, and a darkness at noon.

stories.title: The burial
stories.blurb: Joseph of Arimathea asks for the body and lays it in a tomb cut from rock.

stories.title: The empty tomb
stories.blurb: The stone is rolled back. He is not here. The oldest ending of Mark stops on their fear.

stories.title: Mary Magdalene
stories.blurb: She thinks he is the gardener, until he says her name.

stories.title: The road to Emmaus
stories.blurb: Two of them walk, and a stranger explains the scriptures, and they know him in the breaking of the bread.

stories.title: Thomas
stories.blurb: Unless I see the mark of the nails. A week later he is invited to touch.

stories.title: Breakfast by the sea
stories.blurb: A fire of coals, a hundred and fifty-three fish, and Peter asked three times.

stories.title: The ascension
stories.blurb: He is taken up, and they are told not to stand staring at the sky.

stories.title: Pentecost
stories.blurb: A sound like a violent wind, languages, and Peter's sermon.

stories.title: The lame man at the gate
stories.blurb: Silver and gold I do not have. What I have I give you. Walk.

stories.title: Ananias and Sapphira
stories.blurb: They keep back part of the price and say they have given it all.

stories.title: Stephen
stories.blurb: The first to be killed for the name, and a young man named Saul watching the coats.

stories.title: Philip and the Ethiopian
stories.blurb: A chariot, Isaiah open on the lap, and water by the road.

stories.title: The road to Damascus
stories.blurb: A light, a voice, three days of blindness, and Ananias sent to the enemy.

stories.title: Peter and Cornelius
stories.blurb: A sheet of animals, and a Gentile household receiving the Spirit before they are baptized.

stories.title: Peter walks out of prison
stories.blurb: James is killed. Peter, chained between two soldiers, is woken by an angel. Rhoda leaves him knocking.

stories.title: Paul and Barnabas on Cyprus and beyond
stories.blurb: A magician, a sermon in a synagogue, and a crowd that wants to sacrifice to them and then stones them.

stories.title: The council in Jerusalem
stories.blurb: Must Gentile believers be circumcised? The apostles say no, and write a letter.

stories.title: Thecla
stories.blurb: A later telling: a woman who hears Paul, refuses a marriage, and survives the beasts. Not in the New Testament.

stories.title: The jailer at Philippi
stories.blurb: A slave girl, an earthquake, and a jailer who almost kills himself.

stories.title: Paul in Athens
stories.blurb: An altar to an unknown god, and a speech on the Areopagus.

stories.title: The riot in Ephesus
stories.blurb: Silversmiths who make shrines of Artemis, and a crowd that shouts for two hours.

stories.title: Eutychus
stories.blurb: A young man falls asleep in a window during a long sermon, falls three floors, and is taken up alive.

stories.title: Paul is seized in Jerusalem
stories.blurb: A vow, a riot in the temple, a Roman rescue, and a plot of forty men.

stories.title: The shipwreck
stories.blurb: Fourteen days of storm, a beach on Malta, a viper in the firewood, and at last Rome.

stories.title: The martyrdom of Polycarp
stories.blurb: An old bishop of Smyrna refuses to curse Christ. The fire will not do its work, and they use a dagger.

stories.title: The throne and the lamb
stories.blurb: A door standing open in heaven, and a lamb that looks slain, worthy to open the scroll.

stories.title: The woman, the dragon, and the child
stories.blurb: A woman clothed with the sun, a dragon waiting to devour, and a child caught up.

stories.title: Babylon falls
stories.blurb: The great city, drunk with the blood of the saints, and the merchants weeping at a distance.

stories.title: The new heaven and the new earth
stories.blurb: No temple, because the Lord is its light, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

stories.title: Ezra's vision of the mourning woman
stories.blurb: A woman weeping for her only son becomes the city of Zion. From the book also called 4 Ezra.
